data.name: Qays
data.gender_notes: Qays is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Qays is a name that signifies strength and resilience. It is derived from the Arabic root 'q-w-s' which conveys the idea of being firm or steadfast. The name Qays carries the meaning “Firm, strong, or steadfast” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Qays usually hope their child will grow to embody firm, strong, or steadfast and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, the name Qays is associated with being strong in faith and character.
data.etymology: Qays belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Firm, strong, or steadfast.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Qays total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: قيس
in_arabic.meaning: اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي يعني الفرع أو الجذم
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، قيس: الفرع أو الجذم، ومنه قولهم: قيس الطائر إذا ارتفع في الجو، وقد ورد ذكره في الشعر العربي القديم، ويعتبر من الأسماء ذات المعنى الجميل والواضح في اللغة العربية، كما أن له صلة بالطبيعة والحركة.

in_urdu.name: قیس
in_urdu.meaning: علم مذکر، عربی اصل، معنی شاخ یا تنہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: قیس ایک علم مذکر ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے، اس کا مطلب شاخ یا تنہ ہوتا ہے، جیسے کہ پودے کی شاخ یا درخت کا تنہ۔ یہ نام عربی شاعری میں قدیم زمانے سے استعمال ہوتا چلا آیا ہے اور اسلامی ثقافت میں اس کا احترام کیا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: क़य्स
in_hindi.meaning: पुरुषवाचक संज्ञा, अरबी मूल, अर्थ शाखा या तना
in_hindi.long_meaning: क़य्स एक पुरुषवाचक संज्ञा है जो अरबी भाषा से उत्पन्न हुई है। इसका अर्थ शाखा या तना होता है, जैसे कि पेड़ की शाखा या तना। यह नाम अरबी साहित्य में प्राचीन काल से प्रयोग होता आ रहा है और इस्लामी परंपरा में इसका सम्मान किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: قیس
in_pashto.meaning: د نارينو نوم، عربي اصل، مانا يې د څانګ يا تن
in_pashto.long_meaning: قیس د نارينو يو نوم دی چې عربي ژبې څخه يې ريښه ده، مانا يې د څانګ يا تن دی، لکه د ونې څانګ يا تن. دا نوم د پښتو ادبياتو په تاريخي متنونو کې موندل کيږي او د پښتنو په ميراثي کلتور کې ځای لري.

data.cultural_impact: The name Qays holds a significant place in Islamic history, particularly in the context of pre-Islamic Arabic poetry. Qays ibn al-Mullawah was a famous Arab poet known for his love poetry and tragic biography. His profound verses have been celebrated across generations, signifying the power of art and the human capacity for expressing deep emotions. This name is a reminder of the rich literary heritage inherent in the Islamic tradition.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Qays represents the human struggle to remain steadfast in the face of life's hardships, be it in love, life, or faith. It is a reminder of the strength and courage needed to confront challenges and persevere towards spiritual growth. This name not only reflects the idea of being strong and resilient but also carries an inferred hope, that with strength and resilience, comes the ability to overcome adversity.
